zh.title: 波音777X須拆修30架已完工飛機以交付
zh.summary: 波音777X延遲；30架完工機須拆修；交付前已需整修
body: 9月6日，Simple Flying報導，波音777X項目因延遲問題，必須對30架已完工飛機進行拆解整修，才能交付給航空公司。
該計畫早前獲美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）核准啟動認證試飛，首架交付預計2027年；漢莎航空亦表示將拒收部分早期生產的777-9，並與波音協商修修方案。
波音工程師近期以簡易落葉吹風機鎖定2024年推力連桿問題，測試機隊累計飛行達4,800小時，推動認證進程。
新一代GE9X渦扇發動機將專供777X機型，成為該計畫唯一動力來源。

en.title: Boeing Must Tear Open 30 Completed 777X Jets Before Delivery
en.summary: Boeing 777X delays force teardown of 30 completed jets before delivery
body: On 6 September, Simple Flying reported that Boeing's 777X program, plagued by delays, must tear open and modify 30 completed jets before they can be delivered to airlines.

The programme previously secured FAA approval to begin certification flight testing under Type Inspection Authorization 4B, with first delivery targeted for 2027; Lufthansa has also said it will reject some early-production 777-9s and is negotiating modifications with Boeing.
Boeing engineers recently used a simple leaf blower to pinpoint the 2024 thrust-link issue, and the 777-9 test fleet has accumulated 4,800 flight hours as the programme moves toward certification.
The next-generation GE9X turbofan will be the exclusive powerplant for the 777X, making it the programme's sole engine source.
